title: Who Can It Be Now?
lyrics:
[00:17.20]Who can it be knocking at my door?
[00:20.61]Go away, don't come 'round here no more
[00:24.39]Can't you see that it's late at night?
[00:28.20]I'm very tired, and I'm not feeling right
[00:32.13]All I wish is to be alone
[00:35.61]Stay away, don't you invade my home
[00:39.64]Best off, if you hang outside
[00:43.05]Don't come in, I'll only run and hide
[00:46.90]Who can it be now?
[00:49.46]Who can it be now?
[00:54.57]Who can it be now?
[00:58.12]Who can it be now?
[01:02.48]Who can it be knocking at my door?
[01:05.84]Make no sound, tip-toe across the floor
[01:09.73]If he hears, he'll knock all day
[01:13.05]I'll be trapped, and here I'll have to stay
[01:16.29]I've done no harm, I keep to myself
[01:21.04]There's nothing wrong with
[01:22.55]My state of mental health
[01:24.69]I like it here with my childhood friend
[01:28.42]Here they come, those feelings again
[01:32.55]Who can it be now?
[01:34.82]Who can it be now?
[01:38.87]Who can it be now?
[01:41.99]Who can it be now?
[01:46.92]Is it the men, come to take me away
[01:50.70]Why do they follow me?
[01:54.61]It's not the future that I can see
[01:57.99]It's just my fantasy
[02:01.17]Yeah!
[02:31.81]Ooh, who can it be now?
[02:37.08]Who can it be now?
[02:40.32]Who can it be now?
[02:43.84]Who can it be now?
[02:48.20](Oh)
[02:52.69]Who can it be now?
[02:53.81](Oh)
[02:59.31]Who can it, who can it?
[03:03.06](Oh)
[03:06.04]Who can it be now?
[03:10.27](Oh)
[03:13.87]Yeah, yeah, yeah
